metadata.question: Was it hotter in a 30 mile radius around Kabul, Afghanistan in February 2018 in comparison to February 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Kabul, Afghanistan (~34.5553°N, 69.2075°E), 30-mile radius (~48.3 km) - Time periods: February 2017 vs February 2018 - Collection: MODIS LST (MOD11A1 or MOD11A2) or ERA5 temperature data would be appropriate - I'll use MODIS Terra Land Surface Temperature (MOD11A1) daily product 2. Masking strategy: - Question is about temperature comparison, not clouds - MODIS LST has QA bands to filter poor quality pixels - Apply QA masking to get reliable temperature readings 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid comparison: Both periods have data and valid mean temperatures - C1: No images found for one or both periods - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after QA masking - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or unrealistic values (e.g., <-100°C or >100°C when converted from Kelvin) - A: 2018 temperature significantly higher than 2017 - B: 2018 temperature not higher (equal or lower) than 2017 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const kabul = ee.Geometry.Point([69.2075, 34.5553]); const radius = 30 * 1609.34; // 30 miles to meters const geometry = kabul.buffer(radius); const date2017_start = '2017-02-01'; const date2017_end = '2017-03-01'; const date2018_start = '2018-02-01'; const date2018_end = '2018-03-01'; // 2. Data Acquisition const collection2017 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(date2017_start, date2017_end) .select('LST_Day_1km'); const collection2018 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(date2018_start, date2018_end) .select('LST_Day_1km'); const size2017 = await collection2017.size().getInfo(); const size2018 = await collection2018.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2017 Images: ${size2017}`); console.log(`2018 Images: ${size2018}`); if (size2017 === 0 || size2018 === 0) { console.log("No data for one or both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create mean composites const mean2017 = collection2017.mean(); const mean2018 = collection2018.mean(); // 4. Calculate statistics const stats2017 = await mean2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2018 = await mean2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const temp2017_k = stats2017.LST_Day_1km_mean; const temp2018_k = stats2018.LST_Day_1km_mean; const count2017 = stats2017.LST_Day_1km_count; const count2018 = stats2018.LST_Day_1km_count; console.log(`2017 Valid Pixels: ${count2017}`); console.log(`2018 Valid Pixels: ${count2018}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count2017 === 0 || count2018 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for null/undefined values if (temp2017_k == null || temp2018_k == null) { console.log("Calculation failed - null values."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Convert from Kelvin to Celsius (MODIS LST scale factor 0.02) const temp2017_c = (temp2017_k * 0.02) - 273.15; const temp2018_c = (temp2018_k * 0.02) - 273.15; console.log(`2017 Mean Temp: ${temp2017_c.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`2018 Mean Temp: ${temp2018_c.toFixed(2)}°C`); // Validate temperature ranges if (temp2017_c < -100 || temp2017_c > 100 || temp2018_c < -100 || temp2018_c > 100) { console.log("Temperature values out of valid range."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Final Answer const tempDiff = temp2018_c - temp2017_c; console.log(`Temperature Difference: ${tempDiff.toFixed(2)}°C`); if (temp2018_c > temp2017_c) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
